# multi-tenant-router

Install: npm install @ferrow/multi-tenant-router
> Tenant resolution with isolation: hostname, header, and path-based routing

Tenant resolution + isolation. Extract tenant from hostname (acme.app.com → acme), header (X-Tenant-Id), or path (/t/acme/...) in configurable order. Per-tenant registry with isolated get/set — no cross-tenant data leaks.

## API
- `ResolveResult`
- `UnknownTenantError`
- `MultiTenantRouter`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
